# systeam_notification_channel (Resource)

Manages a notification channel.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `channel_type` (String) Channel type.
- `config` (Map of String) Channel configuration as key-value pairs. Keys and values depend on the channel_type.
- `name` (String) Notification channel name.

### Optional

- `is_active` (Boolean) Whether the channel is active.
- `organization_id` (Number) Organization ID that owns this channel.

### Read-Only

- `id` (Number) Notification channel ID.
